item.title: Saskatoon police issue fewer traffic tickets due to staffing shortages: chief
item.description: Saskatoon Police Chief Cam McBride says traffic enforcement has taken a hit in recent months compared to previous years, due in part to staffing shortages.

item.title: Idylwyld Drive North proposed for new Saskatoon winter warming shelter
item.description: A new long term Idylwyld drop-in shelter has been proposed to the city, replacing the temporary women's shelter on Avenue C after concerns on the proximity to the Salvation Army

item.title: Penticton soup kitchen scrambles to find new home amid looming eviction
item.description: Penticton Soupateria, a volunteer-driven soup kitchen on Orchard Avenue, received an eviction notice last week, effective May 31.

item.title: Danielle Smith promises Alberta referendum over immigration, Constitution changes
item.description: Premier Danielle Smith said the immigration changes her UCP government has determined Alberta needs to push for are a significant departure from the status quo.

item.title: Canadian designer takes centre ice at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Now in Milan for the 2026 Games, Mathieu Caron says 28 athletes from 10 countries are wearing his designs.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: His representatives said Dane died from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, known also as Lou Gehrig’s disease, less than a year after he announced his diagnosis.

item.title: Surrey police budget slashed by $47M with union sounding the alarm
item.description: The Surrey Police Union stated, in a release, that this represents the annual cost of approximately 87 officers, with the average annual cost of each officer being $158,510.

item.title: ‘Death by 1,000 cuts’: B.C. businesses criticize PST changes
item.description: Some business owners in downtown Victoria say the PST will add to the costs they already pay to keep their storefronts safe from crime and social disorder.

item.title: ‘What are they hiding?’: Okanagan mom denied son’s medical records after his suicide
item.description: “They went to find him for his medication and couldn’t find him. He wasn’t in his bed anymore. They knocked on the bathroom door. Nobody answered,” she said.

item.title: NDP leadership candidates pitch their rebuilding plans in final debate
item.description: Four of the five candidates said they are running to rebuild the party, while Tony McQuail was the lone candidate who said he is eyeing the Prime Minister's Office.
